title: governance-performance-budget
outOfScope: Changing quality-gate membership, disabling required checks, or modifying provider configuration.
Treating local timing data as hosted-provider performance evidence.

sources.reason: WI-11 requires structured performance reporting, budgets, slowest-step diagnostics, and cache validation without skipping security checks.
Existing authoritative quality timing and cache aggregation boundary.
Existing per-gate duration, cache, and execution evidence schema.

riskAssessment.reason: Budget reporting changes CI decision diagnostics and must not turn measurements into permission to omit required verification.

reasons: CI workflow, shared Make dispatch, and governance evidence reporting are high-risk verification boundaries.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the governed Work Item lifecycle and the bounded reporting implementation is locally verifiable.

preReviewWarnings: Budget alerts must identify measured slowest steps without changing the mandatory verification graph.
Hosted evidence must remain explicitly distinguished from local performance measurements.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Quality summaries include total, phase/gate, test, archive, cache, profile, escalation, repeated-check, and slowest-step measurements in a structured Performance Report.
Configured profile budgets are evaluated from a measured baseline; over-budget reports identify the exact slowest step and never suppress required checks.
Repeated equivalent inputs prove cache accounting, and absent cache evidence remains explicit rather than inferred.
CI publishes the structured report and current documentation distinguishes local measurements from hosted evidence.
guidelines: Use quality evidence already produced by run_quality_gate; do not add an independent duplicate execution graph.
Budget evaluation may report or fail the budget policy but must never skip security, release, or required quality checks.
Keep local and hosted performance facts distinct in schemas, reports, and documentation.

intent.problem: Quality sessions expose individual gate timings but do not provide a profile-aware, budgeted report that explains governance cost, cache effectiveness, repetition, or the concrete slowest step.
constraints: Build on existing timing receipts rather than duplicating quality execution.
Do not change provider configuration or weaken required verification.
Do not present local measurements as hosted-provider facts.
intent.rationale: Measured, source-bound cost evidence makes low-risk workflows genuinely lighter while preserving mandatory evidence for higher-risk work.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: budget report captures measured quality cost
scenarioCoverage.expected: A quality receipt produces total, cache, repeated-check, profile, escalation, and slowest-step fields.
An over-budget result identifies the slowest step without changing the quality command graph.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run budget-policy and Makefile regression tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: local measurements do not imply hosted evidence
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report labels its measurement source and has no provider-performance claim.

rawUserRequest: Complete WI-11 governance-performance-budget with structured CI performance reporting and safe budgets.

declaredIntent.summary: Quantify governance cost without weakening verification.

performanceImpact: Adds a report-only aggregation over existing receipts; it must not add a second quality execution graph.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized required Contract and governed Work Item writes for this and future Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
